info.title: Physical Documents
info.description:
The Physical Document Search and Download Service allows you to search for and retrieve company Insurance, Transcripts and Filings documents. Filings include annual and quarter-period reports from EDGAR as well as S&P Global sourced Annual Reports, Quarterly, supplemental, and ESG documents. Transcripts include company conference presentations, guidance/update calls, earnings calls, and a range of other event types. SNL Insurance Product Filings consist of SERFF Filings shared by U.S. Insurance companies that are regulated by the NAIC and offer insurance product rates. We also support Bulk Download service for all documents based on broader search criteria.
  • Filings – See the Machine Readable Filings User Guide for more information.*
  • Transcripts – See the Transcripts User Guide for more information.
  • SNL Insurance Product Filings – See the SNL Insurance Product Filings User Guide for more information.

Note:
  • This API is rate-limited to 1 request per second.
  • Throttling Limit of 48,000(Daily) and 2000(Hourly) is applied for the total number of requests on Production account.
  • Throttling Limit of 12,000(Daily) and 500(Hourly) is applied for the total number of requests on Trial account.
  • Throttling Limit of 100,000(Daily) is applied for the total number of download request using Bulk Download endpoint on Production account.
  • Throttling Limit of 10(Daily) is applied for the total number of requests using Bulk Download endpoint on Production account.

Disclaimer:
*Machine translation: S&P Global utilizes a mixture of human translation and machine translation technologies for non-English language documents. Where machine translation is utilized, there may be a chance of varied articulations, junk characters and so on. Please note that for a small number of filing sources we are returning only the machine translated versions of the original document.

post.summary: This endpoint allows you to retrieve the details required for the original version(s) of documents based on your search criteria.
post.description:
Begin your document search by specifying the document type in the primary filter, docType, in the Parameters section below. Select the appropriate value for your search.
  • FILINGS_DOCUMENTS_API for Filings
  • TRANSCRIPTS_DOCUMENTS_API for Transcripts
  • INSPRODFILINGS_DOCUMENTS_API for SNL Insurance Product Filings


Simply input each required and optional parameter in the query. The unique filters by docType are listed below.
  • Required Filters:
    • Filings Documents: Choose either companyId (limit 10) or institutionId (limit 10) and choose at least one additional pair of Date filters:
      minFilingDate/maxFilingDate, minPeriodDate/maxPeriodDate, minProcessedDate/maxProcessedDate (limitation 90 days per request for all date filter pairs).
    • Transcripts Documents:
      • Choose either companyId (limit 10) or institutionId (limit 10) and minTranscriptCreationDate/maxTranscriptCreationDate (limitation 90 days per request) and documentFormatTypeId (limit 1), or
      • Choose either ciqKeyDevId (limit 10) or miKeyDevId (limit 10) and documentFormatTypeId (limit 1), or
      • Choose minTranscriptCreationDate/maxTranscriptCreationDate (limitation 1 day) and documentFormatTypeId (limit 1).
    • SNL Insurance Product Filings Documents: Choose either companyId (limit 10) or institutionId (limit 10) and minPublishDate/maxPublishDate (limitation 365 days per request) and serffFilingStateId and filingStatusId.
  • Optional Filters: Each document type offers optional parameters for you to refine the set of documents. Choose from the available optional filters in each document type:
    • Filings Documents: fileTypeId, languageId, fileSource
    • Transcripts Documents: fileTypeId, languageId, fileSource
    • SNL Insurance Product Filings Documents: spStatEntityId, trackingNumber, typeOfInsuranceId, serffFilingTypeId
Some file sources might require additional capabilities. If you wish to update your subscription, please reach out to your account representative/Enterprise API Support support.api.mi@spglobal.com.

See the Reference endpoint for the lookup values for the optional filters.

Transcripts Example 1 - Document Search.description: The above example showcases all available required and optional filters for demonstrative purposes only. These are the filters that are available for you to customize your request.

post.summary: This endpoint allows you to download the document based on the output obtained through the Search endpoint.
post.description:
Begin your document download by specifying the document type in the primary filter, docType, in the Parameters section below. Only one document can be downloaded per request. Select the value as below
  • FILINGS_DOCUMENTS_API for Filings
  • TRANSCRIPTS_DOCUMENTS_API for Transcripts
  • INSPRODFILINGS_DOCUMENTS_API for SNL Insurance Product Filings


Simply input each required and optional parameter in the query. The unique filters by docType are listed below.
  • Required Filters:
    • Filings Documents: Choose either documentId, documentVersionId, filingId, or filingVersionId.
    • Transcripts Documents: Choose either documentVersionId or transcriptVersionId or (documentId and documentFormatTypeId) or (transcriptDocumentId and documentFormatTypeId).
    • SNL Insurance Product Filings: Choose either documentId or filingVersionId.
  • Optional Filters:
    • Filings Documents: Choose documentFormatTypeId for the supported format conversions. See the Machine Readable Filings User Guide for more information on all available combinations.

Note:
  • Throttling Limit of 1000(Hourly) is applied for the total number of download requests on Production account.
  • Throttling Limit of 500(Hourly) is applied for the total number of download requests on Trial account.

Document download from some file sources might require additional capabilities. If you wish to update your subscription, please reach out to your account representative/Enterprise API Support support.api.mi@spglobal.com.

get.summary: This endpoint allows you to check the current status of jobId obtained using the submitrequest endpoint.
get.description:
By default, status of all the requests submitted by you over the last 7 days will be displayed. Simply input one of the below optional parameters if you are looking for a specific jobId:
  • jobId,jobStatus,jobSubmittedDate,jobCompletedDate
Once jobId is completed with jobStatus 'SUCCESS', you can retrieve the documents by connecting to the API Drive location. See the User Guide in the docType parameter section below for more information.

parameters.name: docType
parameters.description:
Select document type from available document services. The available document types currently include:
  • Filings – See the Machine Readable Filings User Guide for more information.
  • Transcripts – See the Transcripts User Guide for more information.
  • SNL Insurance Product Filings – See the SNL Insurance Product Filings User Guide for more information.

parameters.name: jobId
parameters.description: Unique Identifier for the job created for fetching the Bulk documents.

parameters.name: jobStatus
parameters.description:
Status of the job. The possible returns are:
  • ACKNOWLEDGED
  • IN_PROGRESS
  • SUCCESS
  • FAILED
  • PARTIAL_SUCCESS
When a specific job is completed with SUCCESS or PARTIAL_SUCCESS, a new folder in the API Drive location is created with this jobId and all the files are loaded in this folder.

parameters.name: jobSubmittedDate
parameters.description: Date and time when the job was submitted.

parameters.name: jobCompletedDate
parameters.description: Date and time when the job was completed.
